title: Second Thoughts
description: The booking wizard is supposed to preserve everything you've entered when you navigate back a step (FR-702). Walk through Origin/Destination, then Package Details, forward to Pricing, then back — and check whether every step actually remembers what you typed.
successCondition: A test fills in Origin, Destination, and Package Details (weight/length/width/height), advances to the Pricing step, then clicks Back twice. Origin and Destination remain populated, but the Package Details fields are found reset to empty — document this discrepancy rather than assuming both steps behave the same way.
hints: The wizard lives at /book once logged in as any role that can book shipments (customer, dispatcher, admin).
Don't just check the step you land on — check every field on every step you've already filled in.
